title: Isolated pytest data and scratch cleanup on Windows
finding: backend/tests/conftest.py evaluated tempfile.mkdtemp() as an argument to os.environ.setdefault() even when scripts/run_pytest.ps1 had already provided S2B_DATA_DIR. Each test run therefore created an unused Windows temp directory with restrictive permissions; cleanup of the wrapper's isolated run folder then failed with Access denied.
change: The test environment now creates its default S2B_DATA_DIR only when the variable is absent. When the project runner supplies an isolated directory, conftest does not allocate a second unused temp folder.

acceptance.reason: This removes a test-runner leak; native desktop launch, signing, and clean independent Windows 11 installation remain open.
